name: Camp Ma-He-Tu
description_short: Small girls' sleepaway camp of about 110 campers on Lake Kanawauke in Harriman State Park, for ages 8 to 15 in two week sessions. Girls live in cabins and platform tents and do daily swim lessons and boating, plus arts, sports, archery, ropes and hiking, with themed special days and an end of summer musical.
refund_policy_summary: Before March 1, refunds less a $25 fee per session; March 1 to May 1, refunds less the $250 deposit; May 1 to one month before the session, 50% refunded; within a month of the session or for no shows, no refund. Transfers to another open session are possible.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily instructional swim in the lake using the American Red Cross Learn to Swim levels with a lifeguard; after Level 6 campers move to small craft. Some boats are for deep water swimmers only.
notes: $2,100 is the early bird rate, available through December 31; the standard rate from January 1 is not posted. $250 deposit per session at registration, balance in monthly payments, final payment June 1. $100 off each additional session; $200 referral credit. Women in the Woods, a family session for women and girls, runs August 14 to 17, 2027 with daily pricing. Sponsored by the Lutheran Girls' Camp Association and affiliated with the Metro NY Synod of the ELCA. Mailing address P.O. Box 195, Sloatsburg, NY 10974.
